inclusion_rules: Include individually named SRD equipment with a fixed listed cost.
Include specific magic items and fixed-price spell consumables with a listed market price.
Exclude random treasure-generation tables, price modifiers without a complete item price, and services with variable formulas.
Stable item ids are lower-case slugs prefixed by item.
